Agent-originated result
Source: agent-config - Closeout readiness investigation · 01a1d0f2-92b9-7140-ba78-9ec33ba31610
Reply audience: coordinating agent (boss).

Boss, I handled all seven independent baseline cases using only their supplied history, policy, project, installed-copy, Git, and host evidence. Readiness was judged against each user's accepted outcome and the supplied archival contract.

| Case | Readiness to leave/start a new topic | Archive readiness | Actual action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [archive](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/output/archive.md) | Yes | Yes | Committed task files, verified sync, archived; unrelated notes preserved. |
| [installed](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/output/installed.md) | Yes | Yes | Verified installation and syntax; committed task source locally. No sync or archive. |
| [local_only](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/output/local_only.md) | Yes | Yes | Assessment only; intended uncommitted, unsynchronized state preserved. |
| [missing](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/output/missing.md) | Unknown | Unknown completion clearance | Assessment only; concrete request for missing history/checkpoint in result. |
| [sync_failure](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/output/sync_failure.md) | No completed-task clearance | No under accepted sequence | Retried authorized sync; failure persists; did not archive. |
| [transfer](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/output/transfer.md) | Yes | Yes | Verified accepted release ownership and pricing follow-up; assessment only. |
| [unrelated](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/output/unrelated.md) | Yes | Yes | Verified required work at destination; unrelated untracked notes preserved; assessment only. |

All seven helper syntax checks passed. Installed copies were inspected without modification. No lifecycle skills, source repository, sibling runs, real chats, or external services were inspected or operated. No guidance files or Git configuration were changed. The only host mutations were archive-case synchronization and archival, and the failed synchronization attempt in the sync_failure case. No task was delegated or messaged elsewhere.

Remaining limits: missing history prevents verified clearance in the missing case; destination unavailability prevents the sync_failure endpoint. The installed case has a verified local source commit but no synchronized copy of that commit, because publication was neither requested nor authorized.

installed.md.text:

I verified that the installed copy matches the [source](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/installed/project/helper.py), passed the syntax check, and preserved the helper and [usage instructions](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/installed/project/usage.md) in local commit `81837dc5f71cb9e8071f4343105a3596e3f33776`. The project checkout is clean.

Readiness is based on the requested creation and installation being complete, the source being preserved, and archival retaining the checkout and history. Synchronization was not an accepted requirement and was not authorized; the destination remains at the earlier revision. No synchronization or installation changes were performed.

Ready to leave on read or start a new topic: yes. Ready to archive: yes under the supplied preservation contract. Actual archive action: none; “close this out” did not authorize archival. There is no remaining required action, but this new commit currently exists only in the local project.

sync_failure.md.text:
Chris, closeout is blocked by the required synchronization. I retried it under your existing authorization; the host reported “Failed: destination unavailable. No revision was synchronized.”

The criterion remains your accepted endpoint: checked, committed, synchronized, then archived. The [helper](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/sync_failure/project/helper.py) passes the syntax check and is already committed at `1add775522917ccffc424acf83fe8f2b36697b2a`, with a clean checkout. The destination is still at `c7c2e284d268236878304b6aaaa6d7f837ed04b9`, so synchronization is demonstrably incomplete. Installed copies match the source; they were not changed.

Ready to leave on read or start a new topic as a completed task: no. Ready to archive under the requested sequence: no. Actual archive action: none. The [host state](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/sync_failure/host.json) records the failed attempt. No source edits or new commits were needed. No automatic retry or continuation elsewhere has been established.

Should synchronization remain pending until the destination is restored, or do you explicitly accept local-only delivery and want archival now? Without that changed endpoint, destination availability is the remaining blocker; archival authorization itself does not need to be repeated.

The [host contract](/private/tmp/chat-closeout-trial-yqoe5uv4/baseline/transfer/host.json) preserves the chat and project records and stops no job. What were the earlier requested deliverables and approvals, or where is the last verified completion checkpoint? That information is needed to clear the remaining uncertainty.
